top: gross dealer commission a month at the average outlet, on about 137 kilolitres sold.
a litre on petrol from 30 Oct 2024: the first dealer commission rise in seven years, and a litigation settlement.
a litre: analyst estimate of the oil companies' petrol margin in Apr-Jun 2026, against about +Rs 10 a year earlier.

sections.h2: Delhi dealer commission on petrol rose to Rs 4.39 a litre after the 2024 revision

chart.title: The only rise since 2017 came in October 2024, and it was a settlement
chart.sub: Average dealer commission on petrol in Delhi, Rs per litre.
chart.source: HPCL and BPCL Delhi price sheets; PPAC.

sections.means: The October 2024 revision lifted Delhi's average petrol commission by about Rs 0.62 a litre, with no change in pump prices.
sections.todo: PPAC should keep its dealer-commission table current past December 2024, so a later revision cannot be missed.

sections.h2: Fixed petrol commission, in real terms, is still below its August 2017 level

chart.title: Fixed petrol commission in Dec 2025 rupees: Rs 3.91 in 2017, Rs 2.69 in Sept 2024
chart.sub: Fixed part of dealer commission on petrol, Rs per litre, in December 2025 rupees.
chart.source: PPAC dealer-commission table (posted 3 Dec 2024); MoSPI CPI.

sections.means: The October 2024 revision restored about 40% of the real loss in the fixed petrol commission since August 2017, on the blog's own calculation.
sections.todo: PPAC should publish the slab-based incentives paid by credit note since August 2017, which its table mentions but does not quantify.

sections.h2: Oil companies' petrol and diesel margin: analyst estimates turned negative in 2026

chart.title: Analyst estimates show the marketing margin turning negative in Apr-Jun 2026
chart.sub: Oil marketing margin, Rs per litre, analyst and press estimates; no audited per-litre figures found.
rows: Q1 FY26, petrol and diesel blended (Nomura)

sections.means: Analyst estimates put the April-June 2026 marketing loss at Rs 6 to 12 a litre on petrol, and no company states a per-litre figure.
sections.todo: Oil companies should report auto-fuel marketing margins per litre in their quarterly decks on a consistent basis.
